No YubiKey detected. On Windows, direct USB HID FIDO access is reserved for Windows Hello.

Workarounds:
 (a) Enable the CCID interface in YubiKey Manager to expose the key via PC/SC,
 (b) Use a USB NFC reader (native CCID mode),
 (c) Run NextSH as administrator (temporary workaround).

PC/SC access to your YubiKey is failing (SCARD_E_NOT_TRANSACTED / 0x80100027).

Workarounds:
 (a) Close all Yubico software (YubiKey Manager, Yubico Authenticator) and any active web browser, then unplug and replug your key: these apps lock the CCID interface exclusively,
 (b) Restart the Windows Smart Card service (services.msc → SCardSvr),
 (c) Use a USB NFC reader (native CCID mode),
 (d) Run NextSH as administrator.

Note: native Windows WebAuthn API integration is planned for a future release.
